step.prompt: /crew-sync Add 'cursor' to the tools in .anycrew/config.json and regenerate the assistant files. Report what was written and what was skipped. Do not ask questions.
step.judge: Score 5 if the config lists cursor, the .cursor files exist, the reply distinguishes written from skipped files, and hand-written files were not overwritten; 3 if regenerated but the report is vague; 1 if it edited generated files by hand instead of running the CLI.

judge.reason: .anycrew/config.json tools now lists \"claude\" and \"cursor\"; .cursor/ holds 26 CLI-generated files (8 .mdc rules, 17 agents, hooks.json) each carrying the `anycrew:generated` marker; the reply separates written (32) from skipped (84 unchanged, AGENTS.md untouched) and flags the six regenerated skill files with a restore command; hand-written AGENTS.md and the pre-existing docs/ edits were not touched.
